en.headline: Fujian chef Levi You opens Hokkien House in Central
en.dek: The Zhangzhou-born chef-patron, winner of the inaugural Michelin Guide Fujian Young Chef Award, began service on Friday at H Queen's on Queen's Road Central.
body: Hokkien House, a new Fujian restaurant, began service on Friday on the 21st floor of H Queen's at 80 Queen's Road Central. It is led by chef-patron Levi You, who is from Zhangzhou and previously headed the Chinese restaurant at the Conrad Xiamen.

You received the Young Chef Award in the first Michelin Guide Fujian in 2025. Dining publications said the opening menu is arranged in nine sections drawn from different parts of Fujian, using seafood from the province, seasonal Hong Kong produce and stocks made in-house. Dishes listed ahead of opening included Fuzhou drunken pork ribs, steamed glutinous rice with mangrove mud crab, and a chilled threadfin preparation served with vinegared seaweed.
The restaurant's Chinese name is 福上. Preview coverage said it opened on a reservation-led à la carte tasting format. Hours and prices were not confirmed on an official listing at the time of writing.

zh.headline: 福建年輕廚師游振龍中環開「福上」
zh.dek: 漳州出生的主廚兼東主上周五在皇后大道中H Queen's二十一樓開業，他是首屆《米芝蓮指南．福建》年輕廚師獎得主。
body: 新開福建菜餐廳「福上」（Hokkien House）上周五起在中環皇后大道中80號H Queen's二十一樓營業，由主廚兼東主游振龍主理。游振龍生於漳州，曾任廈門康萊德酒店中餐廳行政總廚。
他在2025年首屆《米芝蓮指南．福建》獲得年輕廚師獎。飲食刊物報道，開業餐牌按福建不同地區分為九個類別，採用福建海鮮、香港時令食材及店內自製高湯。開業前公布的菜式包括福州醉排骨、紅樹林紅螳蒸糯米飯，以及配醋漬紫菜的午魚冷盤。
餐廳中文店名為「福上」。預覽報道指開業初期以預約套餐點菜形式運作。截稿時官方公開資料尚未列明營業時間及價錢。
